reserveReview.rationale: The issuer snapshot published 14 October 2026 reports USDQ reserves at 30% cash and 70% government bonds with a 102.10% reserve ratio. The two published categories total 100%, closing the earlier 1% unclassified tail; the 30 August 2026 snapshot (33% cash, 66% bonds, 101.91%) is superseded and not carried forward. Bank identities, bond maturities and independent assurance remain undisclosed.
